nom: The Ordinary Retinol 0.5% in Squalane, Intermediate Retinol Serum

avis.texte: the product works I'm getting results but I just prefer a cream to this

I was diagnosed with hormonal acne, and found retinol works to clear skin beautifully! Always fought breakouts and lost. Clears darks spots, evens skin tone, smooths skin. 1st time users should research best use practices. ❤️
love this product, it's not for beginners with retinol. It is a oil texture, but my skin drank it up. brighter skin, faded dark spots, even tone and worked on wrinkles. love it and I love this line.
Great price bought this to use on the body so needed and more economical price point

This product is trash and the pipe over.Ordinary is also trash. I've used the eyelash syndrome 46 months.I've used the other serums 4326 months and there is absolutely no difference for the better in my skin. The vitamin c serum in particular, leaves my face sticky.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love this serum! My face tends to be oily and normally all other serums leave my skin feeling extra oily. Not this one! I was very surprised to see and feel the difference the next day, I finally found a serum that fits my skin complexion!

First of all this isn't a Serum! This a freaking oil. Second of all this isn't for sensitive skin! If you have sensitive skin and are new to retinol do not use this. This is probably for more experienced retinol users or people who don't have fair sensitive skin

I've used products from the Ordinary for years, as well as using retinol from different brands for years. This is the first time a skincare product has ever broke me out this bad, and I don't have sensitive skin at all. It gives me small itchy bumps all over my cheeks and forehead that take days to go away. I thought that it was a different product that was causing it at first, so I used this 3 times before I realized this serum was the culprit. I'll definitely continue buying from this brand because I love their other products, but I'll be avoiding their retinoids from now on.
I use this 6 nights a week (not the night I exfoliate with Glycolic acid). It's a little greasy and will pill if the previous skincare is not fully absorbed.
Works great on arms, thighs and butt for keratosis pilaris, absorbs much faster than Amlactin.

avis.titre: This does not work for me.
avis.texte: I have been using this for 4 weeks, once a day with one to two drops. I've used retinol before, but I wanted to try this because it's affordable. I usually had a 3-4 day purge period, but my acne has not let up after 4 weeks of use. The last week I've used it every other day but still. Nothing else is new in my routine. Never again—I threw this away. I wish I could attach the photos of my skin right now. I am so frustrated!
I was skeptical but my 57 year old skin feels so smooth and the few dark spots i have a lightening after a few uses absorbs quickly as well

I wanted to start incorporating retinol in my skincare, so I decided to start with a more cost effective option rather than jumping to a $100 product I may or may not like. I ended up loving this product! It's been about 5 weeks since first trying it, and my skin texture and appearance has improved a lot. Almost all of my dark spots are gone, my skin is brighter, and more even overall. I like how the retinol is half strength of other products, and the squalane allows for some moisture support. Niacinamide makes me break out, so the squalane is a nice combination and I have had no problems with a break out since using the product.
I pair this with Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid and my face feels amazing!
Goes on smooth. Absorbs quickly. Works wonders on my dark spots, is giving me a more even complexion, and provides moisture overnight. Amazing product for the price.
This product is SO oily and will not dry down whatsoever so I can apply the rest of my skincare routine. It's straight oil. Not a fan.

avis.titre: So Oily - Just sits on the skin
avis.texte: This retinol serum is beyond oily. It just sits on the skin and rubs off with an oily sheen on anything you touch to your face. Would not recommend.
Product is more of an oil, but leaves my face feeling soft and smooth. Unscented

avis.titre: I like the brand and I'm still trying this product.
avis.texte: I have several serums from this brand and I really like them. I confess that I'm going slowly because I have sensitive skin and I don't use much product to avoid irritation. I'm not saying that the product irritates, but I think you have to go slowly with Retinol, especially if you have sensitive skin. I really like the feeling it leaves on the skin.

Allergic to nightshades? I found out I am tomatoes, bell peppers. Who would have thought this Retinol 0.5% in Squalane intermediate Retinol serum would have it in it! I should have look at ingredients list.... Solanum Lycopersicum (Tomato) Fruit Extract.... Do not use if you have allergy.

I tried this as an alternative to my favorite retinol serum that works really well but is much more expensive. This works very well, too. I do get more irritation with this one than my regular brand (Peter Thomas Roth) but it's not bad considering I have pretty sensitive skin. I love the idea behind this line. Well worth trying.
This is making such a difference in my skin. I am in my 60s and this has helped with keeping my skin looking more healthy.

After a life changing injury 6 years ago, my skin changed from mildly oily to sensitive and dry. Prior to the 0.5% retinol in squalane I was using the AHA/BHA and it burned my skin 🥺. This one is perfect and my skin loves it.

I appreciate the price point of the Ordinary products, makes a beauty routine attainable. Personally I am not one that spends a lot of time waiting for layers of product to dry with multiple steps. I have a great lotion that I've used for years and I just add a couple drops of retinol with my lotion and apply to my face and neck before bed, so far so good.

avis.titre: Works on dark spots, but not for acne-prone skin
avis.texte: This stuff really did work on my dark spots - I noticed an improved difference in 3-4 weeks. But I think the oil delivery was way too much for my sensitive skin and I broke out in cystic acne. I so wanted to like this product!

I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. I combine The Ordinary with COSRX Snail Mucin products and a Mario Badescu toner for the best results. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. I started with this Retinol Serum, but switched to the Retinoid Emulsion because this product is counter effective with the copper peptide serum and the Emulsion is not. I have seen better results with the Emulsion.
This retinol has already made a difference on my face and it's only been 2 weeks. It is smoothing out all the lines. Definitely would recommend.

avis.titre: This one works for my skin!
avis.texte: I have tried other products that contain retinol but they really had no effect. For some reason, my skin likes the oil base of this product. I have t-zone oily skin and because of this large pores in those oily areas. When I regularly use this product my pores appear significantly smaller. I will admit that the oil base is a bit annoying however the workaround for me is to put it on long before I go to bed, allowing my skin to absorb a good portion of the product. When I am ready for bed I cover my face with a gentle moisturizing lotion. That seems to do the trick.
super affordable. Not greasy. Light weight, Works fast. Only for pm tho.

avis.titre: Use it as an Eye Treatment
avis.texte: For experienced retinol users only. This product can be used as an under eye treatment at night. keep away from actual eyes. You are welcome.
I have used this product for just over a month. This is exactly what I was looking for! It work and you can see the difference already.
I have been using "the ordinary" products for some time. I can tell the difference in my skin before I began using it. The retinol is great.

avis.titre: Would BATHE in this if I could!
avis.texte: I like most of The Ordinary products I've tried, but this is the best! I'm older, but have decent, fair but tough skin; it used to be oily, but now fighting dryness and fine lines. This stuff is helping everything. Seriously, I'd bathe in it if I could. Notice no smell at all. Favorite product of any I've used in years. I'm exposed to sun wthout trying, but it hasn't made my light skin more susceptible to burn, etc. Of course, I do NEARLY bathe in sunblock!

I decided to try this out after i finished a tube of the good molecules retinol cream, i felt i was ready for a stronger %. It is not drying or irritating, but its super oily, and i already have oily skin. It also smells TERRIBLE. Omg its so bad i almost returned it right away, i thought maybe it expired or something. It didnt, its just how it smells. On top of all that, i havent noticed a difference in my skin at all. So sadly this product is just not for me, however it may work for you! Just hold your breath when you use it lol

For the last 2 weeks my routine has consisted of washing with micellar water, peach slices snail toner, this retinol product, the Ordinary's niacinamide serum, and Cera Ve daily moisturizer. My skin is smoother because of this product and the others. I'll still get bumps and more so during my period, but I think all of this is working to my skin looking great on a budget! Definitely would recommend.
This product isn't as potent as others but I think it's a good introduction to retinol to help you skin adjust without too many negative effects.

I apply this on my face 5 times a week bedore bed and i have noticed the difference on my face. I have oily pigmented skin and i can tell this product has soothed my skin tone and has made my face look a lot less pigmeneted and more healthy. I have noticed less breakouts using this too. It makes my skin look like glass in the morning and look so healthy. I recommend!
I've been using this for a few weeks so it's a little hard to tell if it's really working but there's no scent, consistency is good, & it's very easy to apply.

Best Retinol I've ever used. Works great for acne scars. I use it every other night & it doesn't dry out my skin. Make sure you put it in the fridge! I think it being cold definitely adds to balancing my skin. A little goes a long way & the bottle usually lasts me 2-3 months. Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: For those who have used retinol before
avis.texte: I love love this retinol and its price point. A few notes after reading other reviews, it does not take much, I use maybe 1/4 of a dropper. Let it sit for a minute or two before putting on moisturizer. it is of course an oil based serum and will absorp slower than a traditional retinol cream. if you have sensitive skin, do not use on your eyelid/undereye and get a seperate eye retinol cream (I like the roc one). Do not be surprised if your acne gets worse at first, your skin probably needed a purge. Keep your routine simple and limit other actives at the same time especially vit c or salicylic acid. do not exfoliate the same night. Use it every other day at most when you start, less often if it is your first retinol. The formula is to die for if you use it properly, I never have any redness or dry patches with it. I have combo/oily skin and it is so hydrating and great at keeping my skin barrier happy. As always WEAR SPF!!!

I have been using this for 2 weeks and i have noticed a difference. It has diminished the melasma and made my skin more even tone. I use it every other night but it did take about three applications for my skin to get used to it. I have sensitive dry combo skin and this doesnt irritate at all. I will definitely recommend and purchase again.

I've never gone out of my way to write a review on a product before, but this specific serum is worth writing one. Being 100% honest, this product should be more expensive for how good it feels on the skin. Speaking for my skin specifically, it cleared up some acne, made it feel 10x softer, and gave me glass skin before bed. Now, it claims that it anti-ages your skin, we'll see in 10 years. I can't speak on that now. I will always repurchase this product because of how glowy, soft, and rejuvenated my skin feels/looks after. Everyone should try this prdouct at least once to see if it does wonders to their skin as it did mine. I'm hoping it does!!! For my first review, this is pretty long lol.

At 51, finding this for such an affordable price was so cool. Its so anti aging and soaks right in. Youll see a difference in your skin quickly and so will others and they will he asking about it too. 😆. Its so affordable i use it on my décolletage area and shoulders and arms too!
Love this product. It glides on smoothly on freshly washed face. Pairs great with my other products, had no irritation or breakouts. Will be purchasing again.

Do not buy this product. It is to high a percentage of retinol and even using the sandwich method it broke my skin barrier and caused perioral dermatitis. I tried mroe than once to ensure which product was causing it and every time i used this it would cause perioral dermatitis. Get a .1-.3% do not get this 0.5% it will damage your skin.

avis.titre: Not good for my skin at all.
avis.texte: I bought this in January 2024 bc my skin was not looking its best after getting off birth control. I started using it as directed (once a week, then twice a week, until you work up to every night). I wore sunscreen religiously during the day too. I broke out the worst i ever have in my life in February a couple weeks after starting but i chalked it up to "purging." Finally, i finished the bottle in late April and my skin was still awful and worse than when i started it. Most research said the purge will last between 2-8 weeks but after 12 weeks and just seeing my skin worsen, I had to stop. I even bought a second bottle for when I ran out but I wont touch it now. Maybe it works for some people but this greasy oily formula WRECKED my skin. Using differen gel and good molecules niacinimide the past 2 months has helped tremendously though.

For my dry skin girlies who struggle with acne this one is for you!! After trying this for a good 3 weeks I see significant chanfes to my skin! Ive struggled with acne & was trying different retinol products and none produced such great results so quickly (to me 3 weeks is quickly). Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Takes time but it is worth it
avis.texte: My sensitive and very very dry skin loves this product. I've been using this for over a year now (new bottle every 3 months as it expires) and the change in my skin great. The only thing is it makes your skin super super sensitive to the sun so I will probably stop using it for the summer.

I have used this product for a few years but have suddenly become sensitive towards it. I've experienced really bad burns around my eye, on my lips and cheeks. Every time I try to reintroduce it gradually it reacts again. I won't be using it anymore.

I used this for a few days and it gave me retinol burn. Changed the whole texture of my skin and made it rough and dry and to where now i'm applying aloe vera to my skin trying to repair it and can't wear makeup if I wanted to.

I'm 30yo with light skin, freckles, and some hormonal acne. My face is very tolerant to strong products as I've used many over the years for cystic acne etc. I started slacking on my skincare over the last year and my face was struggling - my blemishes wouldn't go away with my salicylic toner and my overall skin was looking tired, uneven, and dull. I needed something intense enough to give my face a "fresh slate" while I build up my routine again. I applied this at night & woke up with smooth, brightened skin. I could feel it "working" right away, which I love. My blemishes are now all shrunken & less red. I'm so happy with it - exactly what I needed.

I am a huge ordinary fan however this product needs to be fixed as someone who has combination skin. I'm lucky to be able to use most products. However, this product is so oily, and my skin did not seem to absorb the oil at all. I feel like because my skin cant absorb it I didn't get the benefits, I don't recommend this unless you have super dry skin even then it's just so messy. You also need to refrigerate it. Which I don't really like because I like to have my skin care accessible and it only lasts three months. I am switching to the emulsion formula which is a more creamy formula and I'm hoping this gets reformulated. I thought about returning this product but instead I just threw it away. I've never thrown a skincare product away. I am disappointed because this is such an affordable price point and I love that they have different percentages, but I'm hoping that the ordinary considers evolving this product into a more creamyformula or like a water-based type serum

This product is extremely oily , thin, and just sits on the skin . It doesn't absorb. You cant layer any product or moisturizer over it . Don't get fooled by how inexpensive it is. Spend a little more for a product with results .

Did not at all feel the way retinol feels when applied. felt like straight bay oil being rubbed onto my oily prone skin. Did not act as a rentinol at all. (oily skin, don't recommend), but love the ordinary niacinamide 10% and zinc 1%

avis.titre: I would buy this again. Love it!
avis.texte: I have only been using for almost 2 weeks, but I love it and I can tell the difference in my skin.

I love the Ordinary products. Feels so good when it's on my skin, but they need to put must be refrigerated in big bold letters. I only knew by reading the the review first. This is the first with retinol that needed to be refrigerated, must be because of squaline. But I would definitely do it again
I never write reviews, but after about a week of use my skin has seen visible improvements in tone, fine lines and diminished scarring. Highly recommend!
I am pleased with this product and see a huge difference in my forehead wrinkles. I am so excited to try all the other products!

I bought this product this month ago. And started to apply three times in a week. My skin is very sensitive and acne prone. Before using this product i only used to have one or two pimple. After using this i have pimples all over my face. I thought it was just a reaction and continu to use but it make my skin worst. As well as this retinol is very oily and didn't absorb in my skin. I don't recommend this product who have very sensitive and acne prone skin.
This works great, but I have no Idea how much I should use. Ive just been doing 4 drops per night.

avis.titre: Im not sure how to use
avis.texte: After 3 weeks of using I started have red and burning feeling under the eyes and round im nor sure if that is normal? I need to know .

There needs to be a warning on this! Its so oily that its unomfortable. Youre supposed to put a moisturizer on top of your retinol, but there is no way for the moisturizer to get to your skin after you put this on. Not to mention - the oil caused a horrible breakout. I'll stick with retinol serum for now on.
I really did like this product, after a couple of weeks i can tell my skin is brighter, some of my fine lines are fading, and it wasnt horrible feeling on my skin. A bit oily, but manageable.
I usually love the ordinary's products however the retinol is extremely strong and made my skin feel like it was burning to the point I had to wash all my skincare off

This product left me with a glorious mask of painful hives spreading from my cheekbones to my neck that have settled nicely into a cystic looking rash. Didn't appear until over two weeks of use and slowly introducing. Into the trash!
Very oily texture, would not reccomend if you have oily skin like me.
Fantastic product! Hasn't caused any irritation and applies easily. My skin has a noticeably improved texture following use.

avis.titre: Wish they made a smaller size
avis.texte: I really like this product but I wish they would make it in a smaller size. I only use retinol twice a week and I barely get through a third of a bottle before it goes off. I hate wasting the product. A 15 ml size would be perfect.

I was struggling with deep cystic pimples on my cheeks and decided to give this a go, and i have been surprised by the results. I havent developed a new cyst since i have started when i would get a new one every week before ! I have also noticed a huge different in my skin texture and i have only been using this for 2 weeks! Try it!
Great product for the price. Not greasy at all. Will continue buying it. I'm on my 3rd bottle. Dries up quickly after applying. No harsh smells.

I started using Retinol regularly since October and it has actually made a difference to fine lines! My skin looks plumper as well. I did have to use it in combination with other things. For example you're not meant to mix Vit C suspension with retinol so I use Vit C on a night I don't use retinol. I've also been recently using argireline on some days with retinol as well as niacinamide and hyaluronic acid (depending on when my skin either has spots, unevenness or is dry) I also put in under my eyes and it seems to help with dark eyes. I think retinol works best when used in combo as a routine with other things. You're gonna have to figure what else works for you though.

avis.titre: Leaves Skin Soft and Reduces Blemishes Overnight
avis.texte: I've never used retinol before but wanted to try it out because I have lots of post-acne scarring, clogged pores, and have started to notice fine lines (I smile A LOT so my smile lines are especially bad). I was worried since I'd read reviews that retinol will make you break out or irritate the skin. I've had minimal purging, nothing worse than breakouts I would get during my period, and my skin has never been softer. I can tell that my clogged pores are clearing out too. I don't think I've been using long enough to see differences in my fine lines, but if I go to bed with a blemish, I wake up with the softest skin and the breakout is gone! I use it almost every night without any issue and it's a total game changer!

avis.titre: Very effective, a bit irritating & drying
avis.texte: The retinol serums have been the most effective product I've tried from The Ordinary. I started with the 0.2%, and moved on to this one after finishing that bottle. The .2 didn't cause any irritation or dryness; with this one, I have had some of that, but I can also see it being more effective in fading hyperpigmentation and smoothing wrinkles. It's worked better for my sun spots than all the other products from TO I tried. The only downside is it has to be refrigerated, so can't be used when travelling. I will probably not stop at 3 months but use it till it's used up, like the first one. We'll see how my skin continues tolerating it and whether I move to the 1% or just stay with 0.5.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: This product was recommended for reducing the appearance of bags under the eyes. I can observe no results at all. All of folks close to me can see no results at all. The only good thing about this product: it is less costly than the $45 stuff
Ive accidentally frozen my retinol in squalene , it got thick and icy, can I put it in room temperature and use it once it gets back to the liquid form or it will damage its formula ?
I don't understand why the rating is low. This is the best product for my skin and I receive a lot of compliments for my youthful look. Highly recommend

i first started using retinol to combat extremely stubborn acne and its really helped clear my skin up, its given me a more even complexion and overall healthier looking skin. although i very much recommend being careful when first starting to use it because it can cause irritation. If you are new to it, start with a little bit every second night and slowly heighten the amount, over time your skin will be able to handle more and more. Retinol is a great longterm skincare product, be consistent and you'll see wonderful changes!
Other than the expected dryness, the product also caused eczema on my face. I have had it for 4 weeks and I am working with my gp to resolve this problem. I put this product straight in the bin!

avis.titre: My third or fourth bottle of this
avis.texte: I have used The Ordinary products for a few years. Love almost all of them. This one is very good.
I'm 51 years old and don't look it because of ordinary retinol facial oil.
If I leave this out a couple times on my countertop over night does it lose potency

I expected better from this brand and didn't even look when i bought it. after using this multiple times I realized it has bht in it, a known carcinogen and endocrine disrupter. I will no longer buy this brand and will have to just do away with this full bottle of retinol.

avis.titre: where ia the old version of Retinol 0.5%
avis.texte: I don't like this new formula it maybe works better for people with dry skin but with my oily skin I really struggled to get results, I can't find the original old formula anymore which worked wonders on my skin

avis.titre: Helps With My Aging Arm Skin
avis.texte: I use this on my arms at night. It's helping reduce the crepiness of my skin. I follow with a good moisturizer once the retinol has dried.

avis.titre: Where's the button to ask a question?
avis.texte: I just got this, not sure yet how I feel about it. It feels super oily for hours and it smells bad. I keep it in the fridge but I don't think it had a chance to go bad in the couple days it took to ship? I have high hopes but not sure I want to continue to use if it's not supposed to stink…

My skin lovesss this stuff. I know squalene is hit or miss with some people but it works great for me (dry/combination with dark spots) Really good for its pricepoint. I may be ready to move on for a stronger rentinol but will always love this stuff because of how nice it was on my sensitive skin
I have sensitive eczema and acne prone skin and this serum has cleared my acne without causing me any flare ups. sadly, it does expire fairly quickly

I like this product allot. Thank God I read review. I would have missed the part to refrigerate it. It is oily but a little goes a long way. I have notice some improvement around the forehead area. Will continue using it

avis.titre: Love the product but causes bad Insomnia
avis.texte: I really love what retinol does to my skin, but I noticed that it messes with my sleep. Every time I use a retinol product topically I get really bad insomnia. Apparently does retinol enter the bloodstream. There are so many people talking about this on the internet…. Definitely more research and informations about the side effects needed?!

This product has changed my skin in ways that it has never been changed before! I use it every other night and My skin is so smooth and looks so healthy. I would definitely recommend anyone to use this!

I am 35 years old and retinol 0.5% works for me perfectly. My skin did get some flakes after a week of using it but I massaged my face with a brush and they all went away. I use sunscreen even on cloudy days - noticed that my skin got a bit more sensitive to sun, but nothing too bad. Overall, it got noticeably fresher and nicer, more even. I keep my bottle in a fridge and use this solution not only for my face but also for my neck and chest, hands, elbows and feet (but not everyday).

avis.titre: Amazing product, I have literally grew new skin
avis.texte: I can't recommend this product enough I have literally grew a new layer of skin I'm shook. It's oil based which doesn't dry out your skin neither
This is an excellent product for my 48 year old skin! I apply it right after I wash and use my hyaluronic acid, then use my night cream. It feels amazing and I feel it keeps moisture locked in. 10/10

avis.titre: Only retinol that truly gets rid of my acne
avis.texte: I've been using this product for around about two years and it's by far my favourite retinol serum. It's not harsh and painful like some other retinols I've used. I love the glow it gives my skin.

avis.titre: Yes, I will definitely buy this again
avis.texte: Ordinary has amazing products, and I am so happy that I was introduced to them
I've refrigerated this serum. When I put it on it is oily but there are also solid particles that I'm not sure should be there - any advice?

I began using this paired with the glycolic acid solution alternating days between each product and I broke out a bit so I stopped using the glycolic acid and used the retinol for 6 wks. I began seeing visibly brighter skin but as my entire face brightened so did my marks. Now I'm using it as a spot treatment instead. I also use on my bikini line after exfoliating. For reference I professionally wax and used to suffer from ingrowns. So far, so good. Consistency is key. Follow the directions.

I general have oily skin so I use face wash specifically for oily skin and I use a moisturizer that is not heavy. I have been using vitamin C serums for the longest just because I have been scared to venture out. I decided to buy a couple different serums from The Ordinary and this is the first one I am using. I use this TWICE a day despite what the directions say. My skin is very very smooth now and I notice my blemishes slowly fading away. This serum is very greasy HOWEVER you do not need more than 3 drops anyways. I love this product and will most likely use it again.

This product is SO oily! It takes FOREVER to sink into the skin. I would put it on in the morning and it would still be on the face tikl 5 o clock!! its crazy. I also did not see a difference while using this. dont get it

I have used retinol for a number of years and wanted to try this one. I was really surprised at how cheap it was. At first I though oh no, this is not a serum it's an oil! How on earth is my night cream going to penitrate this? I was also worried as my skin is really oily . But wow! I am so impressed I use a small amount every night then apply my night cream, about an hour later. My skin is so much smoother and more supple. It does feel greasy going onto the skin. But it does not make my skin oily or shiny! In fact during the day it has been less oily. My wrinkles around my eyes are fading. I spend a huge amount of money on skin care usually, but I am going to start slowly swapping things to this brand. I have been so impressed with this retinol. Better than the premium brands!

I have been using this product now for roughly 2 months. While I have some areas on my face that seem smooth, I never really had bad skin before.. now I am covered in breakouts, particularly in the areas that I would usually get spots (which I've read is a good sign that the 'purge' is happening). However as I am not usually prone to a lot of acne and I feel this should have stoped by now I wonder wether now I should try a different retinol product or stick it out with this one! I think what has spooked me is that the this product is described as gentle and many report no purging at all! Why am I, Simone who never really experienced acne purging so dramatically!!? I'm now feeling as though I would have just been grateful with the skin I had before! If anyone has any suggestions I'd be very greatful :)

although I havent had any adverse affects, this product contains BHT (butylated hydroxytoluene) which is a hazardous chemicma that has demonstrated endocrine disruptive effects and effects sex hormones and may affect fertility and development. It may be working for you, but in the long run it'll have devastating effects on the body. Good molecules is a good alternative.

I bought this despite the negative reviews of ppl saying it broke them out. I don't have sensitive skin, but wanted to start incorporating retinol into my skincare for anti-aging and acne scars. I've used retinols before without issue, but after ONE use I had zits all over. it was NOT 'purging'. won't be using a second time.

Previously I was using a retinol serum by Olay that was okay-ish with treating acne scars along with preventing new breakouts but I felt like there had to be a better product somewhere else...That's where this serum steps in! Since I am not exactly a stranger with retinol I decided the .5% would probably be safe formulation for me to try and I am so glad I did :) I have INSANELY oily skin but after waking up the next day after using this product my skin was almost completely matte but still felt so hydrated and soft. I also have not had a single breakout since using this serum and overall my skin just looks better! And it has only been 3 days since opening the bottle so I can't wait to see how my skin looks long term. (Hopefully this can help with my black/whiteheads too) With all that being said...Squalane is an excellent skincare ingredient for those who have oily skin and don't let anyone tell you otherwise. The product might feel oily upon initial application but it will dry down. Also if you have never tried retinol before and you experience burning or redness that does not mean there is something wrong with the product...that is just a common side effect of retinol so do your research before purchasing! Thank you to The Ordinary for creating my new favorite skincare product :)

avis.titre: Don't use if you have dry skin!
avis.texte: When I first used this product, I loved it. I would put it on during my night time face routine and I would notice in the morning, my face was covered in dry flakey skin, especially in my T-zone. Then around my forehead and chin area, I would break out. If you have dry, sensitive skin, I would recommend one of The Ordinary's water based products. Those work wonders for my skin!

avis.titre: Works, but not as i expected it to!
avis.texte: After a disastrous experience with ROC's Retinol night treatment some time back which came been highly raved about online, I decided to give The Ordinary's a shot. Although touted as being more irritating than the Granactive Retinoid versions from Deciem, I actually found it to be the complete opposite. Granactive makes my face break out in hives, and that's despite only using once a week for the first 2 weeks and gradually increasing to every 3rd night. I did this for 5 weeks. I never got beyond that, as the itchy redness appearing in the middle of an important work meeting was my last straw with it. For some reason my skin just wouldn't adjust. I then got hold of the Retinol 0.5% and although the hives didn't appear, the acne did! I thought it was just my skin purging but no matter how much I spaced usage out, I would still get them, especially on my forehead and cheeks. As both versions are 'Squalane'-based I'm starting to wonder whether it's Squalane and not Retinol itself that my face is reacting to? Luckily I found good use for it on my KP - which I started with the full 1% and now that that's finished I'm using the 0.5% to maintain results. It hasn't gone, KP isn't a condition you can permanently get rid of unfortunately, but it helps keep it less noticeable and my arms and thighs: where I have it the worst, are much smoother. Now all I need to find is a Retinol that works with, and not against: my face! -> My 'Ulta Beauty Top 7 must-have list' (My 7 favorite beauty pr
